description: This PHP source file is part of a web interface that displays call signal logs. It includes HTML structure, scripts for handling AJAX requests to fetch logs, and some PHP includes for headers and footers.

methods.name: document.ready(function)
methods.description: Initializes page setup, configures AJAX request for call signal logs, and applies pagination if logs exceed 10 entries.

methods.name: $.ajax
methods.description: Performs asynchronous HTTP POST request to fetch call signal logs from the server.
